# Enrich Layer

> Enrich Layer is a data enrichment API platform with structured data on 1.2B+ people, 50M+ companies, and 582M+ jobs. Use our REST APIs to enrich leads, verify contacts, search professionals, and power your go-to-market workflows.

Enrich Layer provides a suite of REST APIs for people, company, contact, job, school, and search data. All endpoints use Bearer token authentication and return JSON. New accounts get 500 free credits at sign-up.

## For Agents

- [Agents page](https://enrichlayer.com/agents.md): Spec, MCP server, auth, credit costs and error handling in one file
- [OpenAPI spec v2 (JSON)](https://enrichlayer.com/docs/api/v2/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.0 spec for every endpoint, with x-credits cost per operation
- [OpenAPI spec v2 (YAML)](https://enrichlayer.com/docs/api/v2/openapi.yaml): Same spec in YAML
- [OpenAPI spec v3 (JSON)](https://enrichlayer.com/docs/api/v3/openapi.json): v3 preview, person profile and company logo only, base URL https://api.enrichlayer.com
- [MCP server](https://mcp.enrichlayer.com/mcp): Hosted MCP server (streamable HTTP, OAuth with your API key)
